verdict.rationale: Statsig documents attribute-based targeting for feature gates: it can change behavior based on device, browser type, version and other attributes, and lets you layer multiple targeting rules. The tutorial also targets mobile platforms and internal testers. Nothing in the pack documents reusable segments that can be defined once and shared across flags, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented reusable segment definitions, rule-operator depth (e.g. custom user attributes, operators), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: Change app behavior based on context like device, browser type, version, and other environment attributes
You can also layer multiple targeting rules and set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.
This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers
